rows.note: App without onError over TinyHttpd, Proxy.to("http://lp-backend.invalid:18087"): the 502 default error body is the FinalHandler HTML page with error.printStackTrace(), which prints the ProxyException's cause chain, so the UnknownHostException message leaks the target host. ProxyException's null message (IR-PROXY-002) does not keep the cause out of the default body; FR-PROXY-015 AC-4's test passes only because ConnectException's message names no address. Same exposure applies to any cause whose message names the target (e.g. TLS host-name failures).
Seam socket whose connect blocks until closed; .connectTimeout(5s).totalTimeout(1s) gives 504 TOTAL_TIMEOUT in ~1.1 s.
Resolver seam sleeping 1.5 s with .totalTimeout(1s): 504 TOTAL_TIMEOUT, no backend connection made.
After the TLS handshake SO_TIMEOUT becomes the read timeout: .connectTimeout(1s).readTimeout(5s) relays a response sent 2 s after the request.

At onError for READ_TIMEOUT, TOTAL_TIMEOUT and WRITE_TIMEOUT the .maxConcurrent(1) counters are 0 and the JVM-wide watchdog queue is empty (no task leak). Watchdog thread properties are wave-19 and not checked.
Chunked (Transfer-Encoding) client body trickled one byte per 400 ms with .totalTimeout(1s): 504 TOTAL_TIMEOUT in ~1.6 s.
Direct middleware calls: READ/TOTAL/WRITE timeouts before the response throw their ProxyException and the app logger gets no error entry.
Over https, a 64 MiB body to a backend that never reads it with .writeTimeout(1s): 504 WRITE_TIMEOUT, not INVALID_RESPONSE.
Over https, total deadline after the head but before the final check: 504 TOTAL_TIMEOUT without X-Backend.

30 requests with the backend answering 270-328 ms against .totalTimeout(300ms): every outcome is a complete 200, a 504 TOTAL_TIMEOUT or an abort with only TOTAL_TIMEOUT logged; slot back after each, watchdog queue empty at the end.
